title: the role of psychological mechanisms in enhancing students’ financial wellbeing: an integration of financial literacy and the conservation of resources theory
core_idea: Integrate financial literacy with the conservation of resources theory to investigate how psychological mechanisms—self-control, mental budgeting, and mental accounting—mediate the relationship between financial literacy and students' financial well-being in a university setting.
tldr: The study aims to examine whether and how financial literacy relates to students' financial well-being through psychological resources (self-control, mental budgeting, mental accounting), using a survey of 781 Indonesian university students and partial least squares structural equation modeling to assess direct and indirect relationships.
